method.name: Perform
method.description: Counts quantities of sun-shapes in shape and stores sub-shapes according to flags

method.name: ModifyBigSplineMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the flag which defines whether to store faces with edges if its 3D curves has more than 8192 poles.

method.name: ModifyIndirectMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the flag which defines whether to store faces on indirect surfaces.

method.name: ModifyOffsetSurfaceMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the flag which defines whether to store faces on offset surfaces.

method.name: ModifyTrimmed3dMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the flag which defines whether to store faces with edges if its 3D curves are trimmed curves

method.name: ModifyOffsetCurveMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the flag which defines whether to store faces with edges if its 3D curves and pcurves are offset curves

method.name: ModifyTrimmed2dMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the flag which defines whether to store faces with edges if its pcurves are trimmed curves
